payload.friendly_name: TOM annex export: an evidence index
payload.purpose_context: Pages already classify the measures they evidence (ADR-0080), but nothing gathers them per measure, shows which measures lack evidence, or gives an auditor a versioned entry point. This mission adds that index as a stable, documented format that a shared organisation bundle (#404) can build on, under the generated-section contract of #359. The contractual DPA annex stays the parties' own document; wording on generated surfaces awaits counsel review.
payload.purpose_tldr: Publish a generated api/tom-annex.json that gathers, per catalogued technical and organisational measure, the documentation pages that evidence it: an evidence index, not the contractual annex.

options: A: build always emits api/tom-annex.json (stamped, source_digest over catalog + classified pages, at = latest input instant); a CLI writes an opt-in committed snapshot (a registered ADR-0087 producer) and --check reports drift of that snapshot against the tree
B: build-only artifact; --check recomputes and compares two builds, no committed snapshot (versioned snapshot deferred to #404 / counsel)
C: committed snapshot is the source of truth; the build copies it and fails when it is stale
payload.question: api/tom-annex.json is derived at build time from committed pages, so ADR-0087's --check and the per-release snapshot need a committed file to compare. Which shape?

payload.final_answer: A: the build always emits api/tom-annex.json (stamped; source_digest over the catalog and the classified pages; at = latest input instant). A CLI writes an opt-in committed snapshot, a registered ADR-0087 producer, and --check reports drift of that snapshot against the tree. Decider: operator, relayed by the dispatcher 2026-11-23 (not independently verified).
